title: KPI Entropy & Resilience Planner (Launch Contingency Workbook)
content:
OVERVIEW:
This workbook is an operational-first KPI tracker that quantifies 'entropy' (unexpected KPI variance) and maps concrete contingency actions to thresholds. Designed to be used during staged rollouts (canary -> slow-roll -> ramp) and 0-72h launch windows.

Quick notes:
- Entropy = weighted stddev across critical KPIs (latency, error rate, cost per token, cache hit). High entropy => risk of cascading failures.
- Use this sheet to drive go/no-go and to automate simple runbook triggers (Slack webhook, autoscale policy).
- Status: draft. Need SRE signoff on automated thresholds (see linked Jira OPS-987).

KPI DEFINITIONS & FORMULA:
- p50_latency_ms: 50th percentile server-side generation time (ms)
- p95_latency_ms: 95th percentile
- error_rate_pct: 5xx + model timeout / total requests
- cost_per_1k_tokens_usd: invoice-level approximation (includes model variant coeffs)
- cache_hit_rate_pct: KV/prefix cache effective hit rate
- model_quality_score: eval pass rate on smoke prompt-set (0-100)

Entropy score (working):
Entropy = round( 100 * (0.35*norm(p95,p95_target) + 0.25*norm(error_rate,error_target) + 0.2*norm(cost,cost_target) + 0.2*(1 - cache_hit_rate_norm) ), 1)
where norm(x,target) = min(1, max(0, (x - target) / (target*0.5))) — normalizes deviations up to 50% above target.
Interpretation: 0-20 low risk, 21-50 medium, 51-80 high, 81-100 critical.

KPI TRACKER (snapshot):
| KPI                     | target     | warn_threshold        | crit_threshold        | owner         | fallback_action_short                 | notes |
|-------------------------|------------|-----------------------|-----------------------|---------------|----------------------------------------|-------|
| p50_latency_ms          | 120 ms     | 200 ms                | 350 ms                | SRE Oncall    | increase-replicas -> enable-burst     | p50 drifting after 12:30 UTC
| p95_latency_ms          | 420 ms     | 700 ms                | 1200 ms               | SRE Oncall    | degrade-model-variant -> route-to-ded | observe tail spikes after 1k req/s
| error_rate_pct          | 0.4%       | 1.5%                  | 3.5%                  | Platform Eng  | circuit-open -> reduce-rate-limit     | check external deps
| cost_per_1k_tokens_usd  | $3.20      | $4.75                 | $7.00                 | Product Ops   | switch-quantized -> restrict-traffic  | monitor invoice tag
| cache_hit_rate_pct      | 72%        | 55%                   | 40%                   | Serving RT    | clear-stale-cache/enable-prefetch     | high variance with new prompts
| model_quality_score     | 94%        | 88%                   | 75%                   | Applied ML    | rollback-prompt-set/rollback-weight   | run evals per release
| throughput_rps          | 850 rps    | 650 rps               | 400 rps               | Infra Eng     | scale-up-nodes -> enable-queueing     | autoscaler cooldown 90s
| downstream_errors_pct   | 0.2%       | 1.0%                  | 2.5%                  | Solutions Eng | fallback-to-sync -> degrade-features  | external API flakiness

Derived sample row (calculation): p95=900ms, error=2.2%, cost=$6.10, cache_hit=45% -> entropy ~ 68 (HIGH). Immediate actions: trigger crit playbook, alert stakeholders, run emergency scale/rollforward.

SCENARIO SIMULATIONS (pre-mortem probes):
1) Canary model variant causes 30% p95 increase after 30m
   - trigger: p95 > warn for 10m and entropy > 40
   - impact: 20% SLA degradation for first-party apps, third-party timeouts
   - quick mitigations: weight-shift 90% -> stable model; increase replicas by 25%; enable prefix cache; notify #launch-ops
   - escalation: oncall -> infra lead -> product ops (15min cadence)

2) Traffic surge (organic) doubles RPS in 12 minutes
   - trigger: throughput_rps increase > 60% vs baseline & error_rate rising > warn
   - mitigations: enable burst capacity (if on Dedicated), apply rate-limiter per token, throttle non-critical routes, temporarily disable big-context models
   - comms: open incident doc, post status at 5/15/30/60 min

3) Cost blowout from embeddings during onboarding experiment
   - trigger: cost_per_1k_tokens rolling 30m > crit OR monthly forecast projection > commit tier
   - mitigations: flip to quantized embedding model, pause onboarding job queue, inform finance owner for spend cap

4) Eval-quality regression (model_quality_score drops)
   - trigger: model_quality_score < warn across 3 consecutive hourly evals
   - mitigations: pause rollout, switch to previous model, kick off focused eval, alert product owners and applied-ml team

RUNBOOK SNIPPETS (copyable):
- Slack alert channel: #launch-ops (pinned playbook + incident doc link)
- Immediate checklist on crit threshold:
  1) Acknowledge alert (owner)
  2) Capture snapshot (curl /metrics -> s3) + attach to incident doc
  3) Execute one mitigation (scale/fallback) and monitor 5m windows
  4) Notify stakeholders and set 15-min checkpoints
  5) If entropy remains > 60 after second mitigation -> full scale rollback with 30m ETA

Escalation contact tree:
- first 15m: SRE Oncall (Pager) -> Infra Eng -> Platform Eng
- 15-45m: Product Ops (Riley Alvarez), Applied ML (Maya Singh)
- >45m: CTO on-call ladder

COMMUNICATION TEMPLATE (status updates):
- Subject: [INCIDENT] Launch rollout - {short-desc} - status: {acknowledged/in-mitigation/mitigated}
- Body: current entropy={entropy}, key KPIs: p95={p95}ms, errors={err}% , cost={cost}/1k , action={action taken}, ETA={eta}
- Post to: #launch-ops, incident doc, @product-leads list

POST-INCIDENT ANALYSIS FIELDS (to populate):
- root_cause_summary, timeline_minutes, mitigations_attempted, time_to_stable, residual_impact, suggested_changes (config/code/process), owner_for_followup

AUTOMATION IDEAS (short):
- wire entropy -> alerting rule in OpsMonitor (entropy > 50 AND p95 > warn)
- autopilot: run one safe mitigation (cache warm, weight shift 70%) when entropy 40-60, but require human approval for >60
- daily smoke eval runner to update model_quality_score -> email digest to applied-ml

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs:
- Agree on exact weighting for entropy formula (SRE + Applied ML input). (TODO: OPS-987)
- Decide which thresholds can be auto-actioned vs manual. (owner: Avery Chen)
- Add billing owner to critical cost alerts and set soft spend cap thresholds. (owner: Maya Singh)
- Add synthetic traffic probes for model-quality drift every 30m across canary cohorts. (owner: Jonah Park)

ATTACHMENTS / LINKS (use these in incident doc):
- Confluence: onboarding playbook (linked_artifacts)
- Runbook snippets: github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-scripts (linked above)

NOTES TO SELF:
- This sheet should be exported as CSV to feed the launch dashboard during run-of-show.
- Keep the 'owner' column aligned with oncall rotations (sync weekly with ops roster).

ENDWORKSHEET
